extraction.Name: Zuzella Little Bear
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her allotment, for she did not want to pay taxes, but she was told that it was necessary that she take it, so she did
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold her half section to Thadeus Slider, of Dewey, South Dakota, for $960.00
extraction.Buyer: Thadeus Slider, of Dewey, South Dakota, for $960.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: there were taxes against it, so it was claimed, and she sold it through fear of losing it, on this account
extraction.Occupation/Income: supported by her son, James Little Bear, who works at common labor
extraction.NOTES: mentally incompetent; health is exceedingly poor, being blind, having stomach trouble and rheumatism; supported by son James Little Bear; never received any help from the County or Government; sold in 1924; document dated November 16, 1928
